raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an arbitrary “primary-country IMDb release date” criterion instead of using the earliest actual public release date already found (Niyoti on 10 June 2016 vs. Angali Pangali on 17 June 2016). This misinterpretation of “came out” led to prioritizing a later Bangladesh date for Niyoti (Aug 12, 2016) and incorrectly concluding Angali Pangali was earlier.
